title: fix: correct GLM Flash cached input pricing
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Corrected cached-input pricing for z-ai/glm-5.3-flash and z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx, billed in Pollen per million cached input tokens. Other input and output prices, access, capabilities, and routes are unchanged: Flash remains available through Quest and Paid access with Fireworks as primary and OpenRouter as fallback; FlashX remains Paid-only with Z.AI as its sole host. Flash’s OpenRouter fallback still costs 5.5% above its listed price. Updated effective-price snapshots and verified cache reuse and wallet charges across text, vision, streaming, and tools.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream surroundings, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
